# 1. Load libraries of functions and data: 

I uploaded data and packages of necessary functions to perform the calculations.

```{r, setup, results=FALSE, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning=FALSE)
#if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
#    install.packages("BiocManager")
#BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
package_to_load <- c("readxl", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "tidyr", "broom", "gplots", "tidyverse")
for (package in package_to_load) {
  require(package, character.only = T); packageVersion(package)
}
extra_to_load <- c("knitr","kableExtra", "stringr", "stringi", "ggrepel","ggpubr", "ggbreak","RColorBrewer","corrplot","edgeR","purrr","pheatmap")
for (package in extra_to_load) {
  require(package, character.only = T); packageVersion(package)
}
```

# 2. Load data and extract values to a new table

Load the statistics I developed in an external Excel table:

```{r}
RNAseq_WAT_salmon <- read_excel("/Volumes/ELENA_3/IDIBAPS/Vicens_RNAseq/RNAseq_WAT_salmon.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Statistics")
```

I also load the metadata table and keep WAT tissue:

```{r}
metadata <- read_excel("/Volumes/ELENA_3/IDIBAPS/Vicens_RNAseq/Samples_code_HFD_MF_2_12wk.xlsx")
metadata <- metadata[metadata$Tissue != "LV",]
```

# 3. Pre-process the table

```{r}
df <- RNAseq_WAT_salmon[,2:25]
rownames(df) <- RNAseq_WAT_salmon$Probes...1
colnames(df) <- mat2[,-2]
```

Matrices design:

 + Diet matrix: 
 
```{r linearModel}
library(limma)
group_a <- metadata$Diet
lev_a <- factor(group_a, levels = unique(group_a))
design_a <-model.matrix(~0+lev_a)
colnames(design_a) <- levels(lev_a)
rownames(design_a) <- metadata$`Short code`
print(design_a)
```

+ Time matrix:

```{r}
group_b <- metadata$Time
lev_b <- factor(group_b, levels = unique(group_b))
design_b <-model.matrix(~0+lev_b)
colnames(design_b) <- levels(lev_b) # Due to "12WK" "2WK" are not going to be accepted, I'll modify them
colnames(design_b) <- paste0("T_", colnames(design_b))
rownames(design_b) <- metadata$`Short code`
print(design_b)
```

+ Gender matrix:

```{r}
group_c <- metadata$Sex
lev_c <- factor(group_c, levels = unique(group_c))
design_c <-model.matrix(~0+lev_c)
colnames(design_c) <- levels(lev_c) # Due to "F" is not going to be accepted, I'll modify them
colnames(design_c) <- paste0("S_", colnames(design_c))
rownames(design_c) <- metadata$`Short code`
print(design_c)
```

Contrast matrices:

```{r}
cont_matr_a <- makeContrasts(Diet = HFD - RD, levels = design_a)
cont_matr_b <- makeContrasts(Time = T_12WK - T_2WK , levels = design_b)
cont_matr_c <- makeContrasts(Gender = S_F - S_M, levels = design_c)
cont_matr <- makeContrasts(Gender = S_F - S_M,
                           Diet = HFD - RD,
                           Time = T_12WK - T_2WK , levels = design)
comparisonName_a <- "Diet"
comparisonName_b <- "Time"
comparisonName_c <- "Gender"
print(cont_matr_a)
print(cont_matr_b)
print(cont_matr_c)
```

Models to obtain the fold change and the FDR:

```{r estimaModelo}
fit1 <- lmFit(df, design_a)
fit.main1 <- contrasts.fit(fit1, cont_matr_a)
fit.main1 <- eBayes(fit.main1)
topTab_diet <-  topTable(fit.main1, number=nrow(fit.main1), coef="Diet", adjust="fdr",#lfc=3, p.value=0.05
                    )
head(topTab_diet)
write.table(topTab_diet, "Statistics_Diet_limma.txt", sep = "\t", dec = ".", row.names = T)
```
